title: Profilin-regulated actin polymerization dynamics at high monomer concentrations
task: Characterize profilin-regulated actin polymerization kinetics and polymerization precision at high monomer concentrations
key_results: Four-reaction kinetic model predicts Michaelis-Menten-like saturation of F-actin growth speed; profilin regulation increases polymerization precision approaching thermodynamic uncertainty relation bounds; unique stall force identifies energetically balanced profilin-driven polymerization
comments: Theoretical analysis rigorously connects kinetics to precision (Fano factor) via thermodynamic constraints, though experimental validation of predicted stall force and profilin-dependent Michaelis constant remains to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: Four-reaction kinetic model of actin-profilin polymerization
Master equation analysis via polymerization cycles

hypotheses.hypothesis: Profilin binding controls maximal polymerization speed via Michaelis-Menten saturation at cellular actin concentrations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by four-reaction kinetic model description of experimental data

hypotheses.hypothesis: Profilin regulation improves actin polymerization precision and approaches thermodynamic limits
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via Fano factor calculation showing enhanced precision approaching uncertainty relation bounds

title: Biomass-derived bamboo photonic crystals for narrowband lasing
task: Develop biocompatible narrowband multicolor lasing substrates from natural bamboo photonic crystals
key_results: Demonstrated narrowband multicolor lasing via quantum dot-bamboo photonic crystal coupling; bamboo inherent hierarchical microstructure eliminates need for sophisticated micromanipulation while maintaining biocompatibility and biodegradability
comments: While innovative in material sourcing and sustainability, the paper lacks quantitative optical metrics (linewidth, Q-factor, wavelength tunability ranges) needed to benchmark performance against conventional synthetic PC lasers.

model_io.model: Bamboo photonic crystal with quantum dot emitters

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lignin resists photoluminescence quenching and cellulose-hemicellulose refractive index difference enable photonic crystal functionality in natural bamboo
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by demonstration of narrowband lasing without synthetic processing

title: WASH orchestrates phagosomal maturation and bacterial killing in neutrophils through syntaxin 19-mediated lysosomal fusion
task: Elucidate WASH-mediated phagosomal maturation and bacterial killing in neutrophils
key_results: WASH deficiency impairs lysosome-phagosome fusion and reduces intracellular bacterial killing; STX19 overexpression enhances phagosomal maturation
comments: Novel identification of STX19 as a WASH binding partner elegantly connects actin dynamics to membrane fusion, though the precise molecular mechanism of STX19 recruitment remains partially mechanistic.

model_io.model: Primary neutrophils (WT vs WASH-deficient)
Mass spectrometry and TR-FRET

hypotheses.hypothesis: WASH recruits STX19 to phagosomes to mediate lysosomal fusion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; STX19 interference impairs maturation and overexpression enhances it

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rac1 rescues phagosomal maturation in WASH-deficient cells
hypotheses.result: Rac1 activation rescues lysosomal trafficking but not phagosomal maturation

title: Antagonistic second-messenger signalling coordinates Pseudomonas aeruginosa surface colonization and virulence
task: Coordinate cAMP and c-di-GMP signaling to optimize Pseudomonas aeruginosa surface colonization
key_results: cAMP and c-di-GMP establish mutually exclusive signaling states controlling T4P functions; both adhesion and twitching motility are required for tissue invasion and damage
comments: The reciprocal antagonism elegantly explains phenotypic heterogeneity in bacterial populations, though the molecular mechanisms switching between messenger systems warrant further investigation.

model_io.model: P. aeruginosa single cells and populations
Human airway tissue model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Initial surface contact triggers c-di-GMP increase to stabilize attachment
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; c-di-GMP activates FimW for bipolar T4P-mediated adhesion

hypotheses.hypothesis: cAMP subsequently inactivates FimW to promote motility and virulence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cAMP induces FimX-mediated T4P polarization and surface motility

title: Host cell identity shapes the replication and evolution of Drosophila C virus
task: Determine how host cell identity shapes Drosophila C virus replication and evolutionary trajectories
key_results: Mesodermal cells supported 10-fold higher viral RNA and infectivity than glial/S2 cells; VP3 R270H mutation independently emerged in three S2-passaged lineages after 15 generations
comments: The identification of cell-type-specific selective pressures on viral evolution is insightful, but the mechanistic basis of why mesodermal cells are permissive remains elusive despite comprehensive analyses of known antiviral pathways.

model_io.model: Drosophila cell cultures (glial, mesodermal, S2 hemocytes)
Serial passage evolution (15 generations)
inputs: DCV in mesodermal or S2 cells

model_io.model: Transcriptomics and proteomics

hypotheses.hypothesis: RNA interference and cGLR-STING signaling account for enhanced mesodermal permissiveness
hypotheses.result: Rejected; both pathways could not account for the enhanced replication phenotype

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural proteins accumulate more mutations under serial passage than nonstructural proteins
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; structural proteins show broader positive selection and recurrent VP3 mutations

title: Soft robotic and computational models of left atrial hemodynamics in sinus rhythm and atrial fibrillation

comments: Novel integration of soft robotics and computational modeling addresses reproducibility issues of animal/cadaver studies; validation against human imaging/animal models strengthens credibility; clinical translation pathway promising but requires regulatory approval.

title: Beyond performance scores: directed functional connectivity as a brain-based biomarker for tracking motor skill learning and retention

title: Virtual screening of Withania somnifera phytochemicals identifies scopoletin and linoleic acid as predicted dual-target AChE/BACE1 candidates for alzheimer’s disease
task: Virtual screening of Withania somnifera phytochemicals for dual-target AChE/BACE1 inhibition in Alzheimer's disease

title: Hierarchical graph attention and memory-augmented learning for spatio-temporal network intrusion detection
task: Network intrusion detection with graph neural networks and uncertainty quantification
key_results: STAR-IDS achieved 87.61% ± 1.22% accuracy on NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018; no statistically significant difference from baselines after multiple-comparison correction; uncertainty estimates achieved AUC 0.89 for error detection
comments: Rigorous evaluation with proper temporal blocking and multiple seeds reveals that reported GNN advantages may be evaluation-dependent rather than methodological; graph-free baselines often competitive, highlighting importance of experimental design transparency.

model_io.model: STAR-IDS (Graph Attention + Memory Bank + MC Dropout)
Baseline models (E-GraphSAGE, GAT, GCN, GraphSAGE, MLP)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph-based attention improves intrusion detection over MLP baselines
hypotheses.result: No statistically significant difference after Holm correction; evaluation choices (temporal blocking, flow ordering) critical

hypotheses.hypothesis: Uncertainty quantification via MC Dropout separates errors from correct predictions
hypotheses.result: AUC 0.89 for error detection; flagged predictions 16–25 percentage points less accurate

title: A privacy aware lightweight edge intelligent framework for real-time lethal threat interception and risk assessment
task: Privacy-preserving lightweight edge object detection and threat assessment for real-time surveillance
key_results: Precision 95.36%, Recall 93.74%, F1 94.54%, mAP@0.5 96.58%; 34.1% localization error reduction, 60.9% false-alarm reduction, 92.8% actionable alerts; 31.8 FPS, 31.4 ms latency, 9.1 W on Raspberry Pi 5 + Hailo-8L
comments: Multi-objective design balances accuracy, computational/energy efficiency, latency, and privacy; temporal validation suppresses transients; threat assessment transforms detections to quantitative intelligence; only encrypted metadata transmitted.

model_io.model: Lightweight detection network (hybrid local-global + multi-scale attention) + Temporal Threat Validation + Context-aware Threat Assessment
Edge device (Raspberry Pi 5 + Hailo-8L accelerator)
outputs: local inference results (31.8 FPS, 31.4 ms latency, 9.1 W)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lightweight multi-scale representation learning improves detection of small and occluded threats
hypotheses.result: Precision 95.36%, Recall 93.74%; temporal validation reduces false alarms by 60.9%; actionable alerts increase to 92.8%

hypotheses.hypothesis: Privacy-preserving edge computing meets real-time requirements without cloud transmission
hypotheses.result: 31.8 FPS, 31.4 ms inference latency, 9.1 W power consumption on Raspberry Pi 5; only encrypted threat metadata transmitted

title: Dynamic heterogeneous graph attention network for spatiotemporal correlation modeling of mine microseismic events and intelligent rockburst risk level reasoning
task: Rockburst risk assessment from mine microseismic data via dynamic heterogeneous graph neural networks
key_results: DHGAT achieved 91.9 ± 0.4% accuracy, macro-F1 0.853 ± 0.008, quadratic weighted Kappa 0.887 ± 0.006 (7956 events, 24 months); surpassed static HAN baseline (89.2%, 0.788) at p<0.01; high-risk recall 80.0%
comments: Dynamic graph topology rebuilt within 48 h sliding windows; three edge types (spatial, temporal, feature similarity); relation-specific attention reveals shift from spatial to temporal dominance preceding failure; 46 ms inference per window.

model_io.model: DHGAT (Dynamic Heterogeneous Graph Attention + GRU encoder)
inputs: microseismic events (node features: waveform, source parameter, spatial, temporal)
sliding-window graph reconstruction (spatial proximity, temporal sequence, feature similarity edges)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic heterogeneous graph representation improves rockburst risk assessment over static graphs
hypotheses.result: DHGAT 91.9% vs. static HAN 89.2%; relation weights migrate from spatial (gradual stress) to temporal (final hours) dominance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Relation-specific attention weights encode discriminative signal for risk stratification
hypotheses.result: Perturbation test confirms attention carries discriminative signal; high-risk recall 80.0%; temporal dominance mirrors coalescence phase before failure

title: Material-dependent structure of roughness representation in generative AI-based texture analysis
task: Material-dependent organization of roughness representation in generative AI texture synthesis
key_results: Feature–roughness correlations vary substantially across materials; Material-Specific Linguistic Model silhouette score 0.271 vs. Quantitative Model −0.065; strongest category associations with material-specific prompting
comments: Reveals that roughness representation in generative models is material and linguistically context-dependent; no single interpretable feature consistently captures roughness across all categories examined.

model_io.model: Generative image model (text-to-image) + Feature extraction (8 luminance statistics + FFT spectral centroid)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Roughness representation in generative models is material-independent with single canonical set of image features
hypotheses.result: Rejected; feature–roughness correlations highly material-dependent; no single feature set captures roughness across all categories

hypotheses.hypothesis: Material-specific linguistic conditioning improves clarity of material-category organization
hypotheses.result: Material-Specific Linguistic Model silhouette 0.271 (strongest) vs. Quantitative −0.065; clear category-dependent feature organization with material-specific prompting

title: Graph convolutional network with dynamic gating LSTM improves corporate credit default prediction
task: Multi-modal credit default prediction via graph-fused dynamic gating LSTM
key_results: GMDG-Net achieved 91.3% accuracy and 0.851 F1-score; outperformed SVM (0.842), standard LSTM (0.889), GCN alone (0.872); public opinion features +2.2%, graph features +1.8% accuracy
comments: Integrates financial data, sentiment text, and enterprise association graphs; dynamic gating LSTM fuses multi-modal features in real-time; demonstrates value of cross-modal integration for credit risk.

model_io.model: GMDG-Net (GCN + Sentiment Extractor + Adaptive Gating LSTM)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-modal fusion improves corporate credit default prediction over unimodal approaches
hypotheses.result: 91.3% accuracy; public opinion +2.2%, graph structure +1.8% over baseline LSTM; robust under class imbalance (F1 0.897)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph convolutional networks capture spatial risk transmission patterns
hypotheses.result: GCN alone 87.2%; full GMDG-Net 91.3%; graph contribution estimated at +1.8% when added to text+financial features

title: Application of spectral preprocessing and machine learning models for discriminating nitrogen levels in cucumber production
task: Hyperspectral machine learning for nitrogen deficiency discrimination in cucumber leaves
key_results: SVM achieved 94% overall accuracy and 0.94 F1-score with no preprocessing and Gaussian normalization; ROC-AUC >0.98; LDA moderate, Decision Tree poorest performance
comments: Hyperspectral imaging (400–1100 nm, 327 bands) paired with preprocessing techniques and three classifiers; SVM robustness to preprocessing variations noteworthy; framework applicable to efficient nutrient management.

model_io.model: SVM, LDA, Decision Tree classifiers + preprocessing (Savitzky-Golay, MSC, Gaussian normalization)
inputs: hyperspectral leaf images (327 spectral bands, 400–1100 nm)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spectral preprocessing improves class separability and classification performance
hypotheses.result: Best results (94% accuracy, F1 0.94) with no preprocessing and Gaussian normalization; Savitzky-Golay and MSC not uniformly beneficial

hypotheses.hypothesis: SVM outperforms LDA and Decision Tree for hyperspectral nitrogen discrimination
hypotheses.result: SVM consistently highest across all scenarios; LDA moderate; Decision Tree lowest; SVM robust to preprocessing choice

title: Multiscale damage evolution mechanisms and life-cycle performance prediction modeling of asphalt pavement for resilient infrastructure
task: Multi-scale damage evolution and life-cycle prediction of asphalt pavement via physics-informed neural networks
key_results: Hybrid model: rut depth R²=0.91±0.01, cracking ratio R²=0.87±0.02; physics constraint raised extrapolation consistency from 0.79→0.93, cut monotonicity violations 11.6%→0.3%; interval coverage 89.4%
comments: Integrates micro-meso-macro damage scales via effective-bearing-area variable; constitutive relations + cohesive criterion + RVE homogenization; gated RNN with attention + monotonicity constraint; laboratory characterization of 216 specimens.

model_io.model: Gated RNN with attention + physics constraint (damage evolution equation + monotonicity)
inputs: material characterization (dynamic modulus, fatigue, wheel tracking)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-informed neural network with damage evolution constraint improves extrapolation generalization
hypotheses.result: Monotonicity constraint raised extrapolation consistency 0.79→0.93, reduced violations 11.6%→0.3%, maintained coverage 89.4%

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-scale transfer of damage mechanisms is nonlinear in temperature
hypotheses.result: Amplification below freezing and above ~45°C; magnitude gradation-dependent; no generality claimed beyond examined materials

title: Expert-derived influence structure and structural associations among resilience engineering indicators in an Iranian petrochemical complex: an integrated fuzzy DEMATEL–MMDE–SEM study
task: Mapping resilience engineering indicators and their interdependencies via fuzzy DEMATEL and structural equation modeling
key_results: Integrated fuzzy DEMATEL, MMDE, and SEM on 12 resilience indicators; expert network + employee survey (343 respondents); final SEM CFI=0.959, RMSEA=0.027; all 10 prespecified paths positive and significant
comments: Bridges expert-derived influence structure with employee-based structural evidence; awareness and buffering capacity identified as evidence-informed priorities; nonlinear interdependencies characterized in petrochemical context.

model_io.model: Fuzzy DEMATEL (expert network) + MMDE (candidate path retention) + Covariance-based SEM

hypotheses.hypothesis: Resilience indicators form interdependent configuration of informational, resource, and adaptive capabilities
hypotheses.result: Awareness strongest associations with self-organization and flexibility; significant model-based total associations with preparedness/fault-tolerance via buffering capacity and flexibility (indirect paths)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Expert influence structure aligns with employee-based structural associations
hypotheses.result: Expert DEMATEL identified management commitment, awareness, reporting/learning culture, teamwork as net-dispatching roles; MMDE retained 10 of 132 candidate relationships; SEM validated all 10 prespecified paths (CFI 0.959)

title: Topological Josephson trijunctions as a Majorana source and path
task: Manipulating Majorana bound states in topological Josephson trijunctions for braiding and topological qubits
key_results: Trijunction geometry enables on-demand generation, propagation, and fusion of Majorana bound states; two distinct dynamics (source/sink and path) demonstrated enabling non-Abelian state evolution detectable by Josephson emission spectroscopy
comments: Elegant proposal bridging topological superconductivity and quantum information, though experimental realization remains challenging due to stringent requirements on superconducting phase control.

model_io.model: Topological insulator Josephson trijunction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phase boundaries in trijunction center control Majorana generation/annihilation vs. propagation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: source/sink boundary generates/annihilates MBS pairs; path boundary enables single MBS motion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Trijunction network geometry enables MBS fusion and braiding without dynamical control
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated conceptually via double-trijunction setup with spectroscopic detection

title: Performance enhancement of electrohydrodynamic thruster using sub unit electrode configuration
task: Enhancing thrust output in electrohydrodynamic (EHD) propulsion via novel electrode configuration
key_results: Sub-unit electrode configuration increases thrust by 27.59% (50.23→64.09 mN at 22 kV); sub-unit plus configuration adds further 7.19% improvement for total 36.77% enhancement relative to baseline
comments: Practical engineering optimization with clear performance gains, but trade-off between absolute thrust and thrust-to-power ratio noted, limiting applicability for energy-constrained systems.

model_io.model: EHD thruster with electrode variations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sub-unit structure optimizes aerodynamic interactions in EHD thruster
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 27.59% thrust increase observed; sub-unit plus adds incremental 7.19%

title: Selectively VO2-loaded terahertz metasurface for dual-state broadband polarization conversion and near-unity absorption
task: Dual-state terahertz metasurface with voltage-controlled VO₂ for broadband polarization conversion and near-unity absorption
key_results: Insulating VO₂ state: PCRx > 0.90 over 1.5–2.58 THz, PCRγ > 0.90 over 1.5–2.67 THz; metallic VO₂ state: Ax > 0.90 over 1.57–1.99 THz with peak 0.9997 at 1.805 THz; VO₂ contributes 97.14% of dissipated power
comments: Elegant conductivity-based switching mechanism in a single planar cell with robust angular/tolerance performance, though tuning speed and cyclability of VO₂ phase transitions not addressed.

model_io.model: Ground-backed VO₂-loaded terahertz metasurface unit cell

hypotheses.hypothesis: Insulating VO₂ enables reflective cross-polarization conversion via asymmetric current paths
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: PCR > 0.90 sustained over ~1–2.67 THz bandwidth with mechanism supported by current distribution analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metallic VO₂ suppresses reflection and couples resonator to ground, enabling near-unity absorption
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: absorption peak 0.9997 at 1.805 THz with impedance matching (0.970 − j0.014) and dominant VO₂ loss contribution

title: Experimental investigation of blade-tip leakage flow control in a low-speed axial compressor using natural aspiration through casing wall slot
task: Mitigating blade-tip leakage flow in low-speed axial compressor via passive casing slot aspiration
key_results: Approximately 1.2% increase in pressure-rise coefficient; stable operating range extended to inlet-flow coefficient 0.28 (vs. 0.32 for plain casing)
comments: Passive control strategy shows modest but consistent improvements; however, admitted mass flow and efficiency gains not quantified, weakening conclusions about fundamental stall-inception mechanisms.

model_io.model: Low-speed axial compressor with rotor blade row

hypotheses.hypothesis: Natural aspiration through casing slot weakens tip-leakage vortex and delays stall
hypotheses.result: Partially supported: extended stable operating range observed, but vortex weakening not independently confirmed via spectral analysis
